# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Empirical-Lane Gate Architecture r0.1

Status: **Stage A successor candidate; no gate is authorized**

## Why The Lane Cannot Be Authorized As One Undifferentiated Action

The accepted architecture requires several quantities to be fixed before
development and a larger complete protocol to be frozen before held-out
qualification outcomes are opened. Those quantities are not presently bound.
A broad authorization now would either invent them silently or permit the
candidate search to shape its own test.

The lane is therefore divided into separately approved gates. Later gates do
not inherit authority merely because an earlier gate completed.

## Gate Sequence

| Gate | Purpose | Permitted access after exact owner approval | Required terminal object |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EL-G0` | registration preparation and feasibility | read-only implementation/document inspection and non-outcome inventory needed to draft exact control, population, metric, candidate-family, execution, and resource bindings | Gate-D owner-review packet or typed no-go record |
| `EL-GD` | quarantined candidate development | exact development population only; bounded prototypes, tuning, feasibility thresholds, and candidate rejection within an approved hypothesis/resource envelope | complete candidate-development record and proposed frozen method/claim/protocol set |
| `EL-GF` | prospective freeze and registration | no new tuning; review and exact-byte freeze of methods, claims, populations, metrics, thresholds, support, inference, multiplicity, stopping, failure, resource, and unblinding rules | owner-approved frozen qualification registration |
| `EL-GQ` | held-out qualification | exact qualification and prospectively admitted challenge populations under the frozen registration; no within-generation changes | immutable paired evidence package and protocol-deviation record |
| `EL-GR` | qualification review | frozen results and audit trail only; no favorable domain carving or candidate repair | owner disposition for each exact method/claim/evidence tuple |
| `EL-GS` | Stage B packet preparation | only owner-approved qualified-method records after sanitization | exclusive implementation-blind author packet for separate owner approval |

`EL-G0` is not empirical method development. `EL-GD` is not qualification.
`EL-GF` does not open qualification outcomes. `EL-GQ` does not qualify a
method by itself. `EL-GR` does not create a scientific contract. `EL-GS` does
not dispatch Stage B without a separate exact owner instruction.

## Identity And Generation

Every gate record binds:

```text
LANE_GATE_ID = (
  SCI-FRUIT program version,
  gate name and generation,
  accepted-input manifest,
  repository and exact source ref,
  access scope,
  admitted data/population identities,
  protocol or preparation plan,
  execution environment and resource envelope,
  responsible people/roles,
  owner authorization and date
)
```

A changed access scope, admitted population, protocol, source ref, execution
environment, resource envelope, or decision authority creates a successor gate
generation. It cannot be treated as the approved gate by compatibility
assumption.

## Recommended Immediate Decision

Only `EL-G0` is presently mature enough to present as an exact candidate. Its
purpose is to produce the missing bindings needed for an honest `EL-GD`
decision. Full development or qualification authorization is not an admissible
current choice because the required exact objects do not exist.

The exact `EL-G0` candidate is in
[`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_EMPIRICAL_LANE_GATE_0_FINAL_CANDIDATE_R0.1.md`](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_EMPIRICAL_LANE_GATE_0_FINAL_CANDIDATE_R0.1.md).
